'''October 2000 Clarks Summit tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Clarks Summit, PA on 1 October 2000. [[Joe Gagliardi]] won it. It is known from Ted Panczyszyn's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1291">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-02-clarks-summit-pa-10-1-00-part-ii-of-iid1291/ clarks-summit-pa-10-1-00-part-ii-of-ii], DeckTech (Ted "Rogue15" Panczyszyn, 2 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-02-clarks-summit-pa-10-1-00-part-ii-of-iid1291/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 1 October 2000
* '''Site:''' Clarks Summit, PA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Joe Gagliardi]]
